DEMO event Hang out Alcohol-free

Trivia night: Seminole County edition

  • Thu, Nov 19 · 7 to 9 pm
  • Casselberry · Free to play

Are you in?

I'm in
SEG+2831 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Seven cities, four SunRail stops, one very old tree. Bring a team or join one.

What's the plan

Five rounds of questions about the county you live in: the cities, the lakes, the history, and one round on how voting here actually works (no gotchas, promise). Teams of up to 6. Came alone? Perfect. We'll put you on a team with people you'll like.

Getting in

Questions are read out loud and shown on a screen. Large-print answer sheets on request. A quieter table in the back if the room gets loud.

Details

When
Thu, Nov 19 · 7 to 9 pm
Where

A board-game café in Casselberry (DEMO venue)

The exact place is a DEMO venue. The real address comes with your RSVP.

Cost
Free to play
Language

In English

Who it's for

14 and up. You don't have to be a member, and you don't have to be registered with any party.

Under 18? Events that end after dark, and door-knocking shifts, need a quick OK from a parent or guardian. We'll send the form when you RSVP.

Alcohol-free
All our events are alcohol-free.
Host
DEMO host · Room for 48 (DEMO)

What to bring

  • A team name (puns encouraged, keep it kind)
  • Nothing else. Answers go on paper, so phones stay in pockets.
  • Money for food, if you want some

Try a sample question

Which Seminole city was nicknamed the Celery City?

Sanford

Source: sanfordfl.gov · Source: richesmi.cah.ucf.edu

How many SunRail stations are in Seminole County?

Four: Altamonte Springs, Longwood, Lake Mary and Sanford

Source: sunrail.com

About how old was The Senator, the cypress in Longwood's Big Tree Park, when it burned in 2012?

About 3,500 years

Source: seminolecountyfl.gov · Source: en.wikipedia.org

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • Four SunRail stations are in Seminole County: Altamonte Springs, Longwood, Lake Mary and Sanford.

    Source: sunrail.com

  • Seminole County has seven incorporated cities.

    Source: voteseminole.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.

Add it to your calendar

Calendar file (.ics) Google Outlook.com

Bring the friend who always wins at trivia, and the one who knows every back road off 17-92.
